findings.title: engine/haat/validate.js:144 flat-fallback suppression still gated on `operatorHaat > 0`; with no operator HAAT and per-radial values present, validator can return PASS with display_suppressed=false
findings.recommended_fix: Drop the `operatorHaat > 0` clause from the flat-fallback gate, OR add a parallel branch for `basis === 'flat' && (!Number.isFinite(operatorHaat) || operatorHaat <= 0)` that returns FALLBACK_ONLY when haats.length>0. Today: with basis='flat' and operatorHaat absent/<=0, control flow falls through to the generic plausibility checks (validate.js:191-225); if all per-radial values fall inside [HARD_FLOOR_M, HARD_CEILING_M] and no nImpl/nSoftOutlier conditions fire, status='PASS' with display_suppressed=false (lines 227-247). The FALLBACK_ONLY emitter at line 169 never fires without operatorHaat — contradicting the design comment at lines 27-32 ('no terrain basis attached but a per-radial HAAT bundle is being emitted anyway → we suppress the column').
tests_required: genoa/src/tests/haatValidation.test.js — synthesize a flat-basis exhibit with haats.length>0 and operatorHaat=null/0; assert display_suppressed=true and status='FALLBACK_ONLY'
findings.reproducibility_notes: Read validate.js:144 gate condition; trace: collected.values non-empty AND haatResolved absent AND collected.source !== 'none' yields basis='flat' (line 115). Without operatorHaat>0 the entire block 144-188 is skipped. Second consecutive cycle reporting this — bump seen_count via dedup.

findings.title: VERIFIED — F-001 §73.215 computePolygonOverlap fix is correct: F(50,10) interfering polygon now built at (other_protected − D/U gate), not at own protected field
findings.recommended_fix: No action — recording positive verification. section_73_215.js:217 now passes cls.du_db; computePolygonOverlap (lines 322-340) computes subject_interfering_field_dbu = nearbyFieldDbu − du_threshold_db and nearby_interfering_field_dbu = subjectFieldDbu − du_threshold_db. This matches §74.1204(c): the F(50,10) interfering contour locus is where the undesired station's field equals (D's protected field − required D/U). The call site at line 217 is unreachable for non_restricted offsets (early-continue at 192), so du_threshold_db is always finite when the helper runs. section_73_215.test.js:172-214 pins the new behavior with explicit numeric assertions (54−20=34 dBu, 60−20=40 dBu, 54−6=48 dBu, 60−6=54 dBu) and an explicit notEqual against the pre-fix degenerate-polygon case.
tests_required: genoa/src/tests/section_73_215.test.js (F-001 repro block, three assertions at lines 172-214)
findings.reproducibility_notes: Read engine/regulatory/section_73_215.js:217 and 322-340 against §74.1204(c). Sign convention check: positive D/U gate values (cochannel +20, 1st-adj +6) subtract to lower interfering thresholds and larger polygons; negative -40 dB gates (2nd-adj, 3rd-adj, IF) subtract to higher interfering thresholds and near-zero polygons — physically correct since -40 dB D/U is geographically tiny.
